target_customer: Solo and small practice therapists and counsellors in the US, Canada and other English speaking markets
problem: Therapists spend large amounts of unpaid time on notes, treatment plans, letters and insurance claims. Klarify's agent Klara drafts these.
business_model: Per therapist SaaS subscription with a free tier and paid plans from 16 to 71 dollars per month
product_category: AI scribe and practice assistant for therapists

founders.name: Moody Abdul
founders.background_notes: Sold 20M dollars of enterprise contracts at LinkedIn per YC. Hosts the Future of Therapy podcast.

founders.name: Alexander Bergholm
founders.background_notes: Built LLM infrastructure at Workday and holds a patent per YC.

competitors.name: Upheal
competitors.what: AI notes and practice platform for behavioral health

competitors.name: Mentalyc
competitors.what: AI progress notes for therapists, priced about 20 to 120 dollars a month

competitors.name: Heidi
competitors.what: General medical AI scribe also used by therapists

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech to note generation uses off the shelf LLM and transcription models. Compliance with HIPAA, PIPEDA and PHIPA adds work.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI scribes already served therapists and models are commodity, so copying is fast. Client history and templates give light switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals were already established in 2026. No outcome yet.

market_need_then: Therapist documentation burden is widely discussed and company estimates therapists lose 1,000 to 2,500 dollars per month in missed reimbursement, a company claim from a launch press release.

branding.domain_note: Uses klarify.ca, a Canadian domain rather than .com.

identity.logo: Letter K beside the wordmark per a directory listing
identity.visual_style: Growth theme with plan names Seed, Sprout, Bloom and Forest
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and professional: The AI assistant every therapist deserves

branding.brand_signature: Klara the named AI teammate and the Seed to Forest plan names
branding.community_and_virality: Founder hosts the Future of Therapy podcast and Klarify runs a public therapist directory.

brand_strength.rationale: Early and young brand with a coherent theme and a named assistant, but only company owned content and listings were found.

outcome_analysis: Klarify is a Spring 2026 company with a public launch on June 30, 2026 and claims between 6,000 and 12,000 therapists using it. Usage claims conflict across sources and funding is unverified. It faces established scribe competitors, so its outcome depends on distribution among solo therapists and its added agent features.
notes: Unverified funding: VCBacked and Caplight list 500K pre seed (aggregators), Wellfound says 1.7M, another lists 125K. None confirmed so no round recorded. Usage claims range 6,000 to 12,300. Headquarters conflict between Toronto and San Francisco. Competitor entries come from 2026 comparison pages that are mostly vendor authored.
